newsitem.title: ITALY: Credito Bergamasco shares stay suspended.
newsitem.headline: Credito Bergamasco shares stay suspended.

text.p: Shares in Italian banking group group Credito Bergamasco will remain suspended today after Thurday's suspension pending a statement from the group, the Italian stock market watchdog body Consob said on Friday.
The shares had been suspended Thursday pending the release of a statement on the bank's future, which is majority owned by French state-controlled bank Credit Lyonnais CRLIi.PA.
The French bank is expected to announce its decision to sell its 56.8 percent stake in Credito Bergamasco to another Italian bank Banca Popolare di Verona, dealers said.
